claude.title: Make the price API explicitly currency-aware
acceptance: Export a Currency TypeScript type whose supported values are USD and EUR.

Make price accept cents and a required Currency second argument. USD converts cents to dollars; EUR applies a fixed 0.9 multiplier to that dollar amount. Return the numeric result without display rounding.
Preserve rejection of cents that are negative, fractional, or not finite. At runtime reject missing or unsupported currencies.
Update known callers and relevant tests to use the new API while preserving the other tasks' behavior. Read the live API and NERUDO receipts when concurrent work changes those callers.

codex.title: Calculate cart subtotals using the shared price API
acceptance: Add src/cart.ts exporting subtotal(items, currency), where items contain numeric unitCents and quantity properties. Currency defaults to USD and supports USD and EUR.
Use the shared price API to calculate the total. An empty cart totals zero. Preserve the inputs.
Reject quantities that are not positive integers, and reject invalid unitCents using the price API's validation. Reject unsupported currencies even for an empty cart.
Add meaningful runtime tests. Implement against the current price API and repair the integration if another agent introduces its required currency argument.

ollama.title: Format receipts using the shared price API
acceptance: Add src/receipt.ts exporting receipt(cents, currency). Currency defaults to USD and supports USD and EUR.
Use the shared price API and return the currency code followed by one space and the amount with exactly two decimal places: receipt(1234) is USD 12.34, and receipt(1234, EUR) is EUR 11.11.
Preserve the price API's validation of cents and reject unsupported currencies.
Use real subagent work if supported by the configured workflow, record those contributions, and add meaningful runtime tests. Inspect current source and repair after concurrent API changes.

gemini.title: Calculate discounts in integral cents
acceptance: Add src/discount.ts exporting discountedCents(cents, percent). Return cents after applying the percentage discount, rounded to the nearest cent.
Reject cents that are negative, fractional, or not finite. Reject a percent that is not finite or is outside the inclusive range zero through one hundred.
A zero-percent discount leaves cents unchanged; a hundred-percent discount returns zero. discountedCents(101, 50) returns 51.
Add meaningful runtime tests and preserve other providers' changes.
